import sys

def document_analyser(doc):
    inside = False
    prev_letter = False
    max_len = 0
    cur_len = 0
    word_count = 0
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(doc):
        c = doc[i]
        if c == '(':
            inside = True
            prev_letter = False
            cur_len = 0
        elif c == ')':
            inside = False
            prev_letter = False
            cur_len = 0
        elif c.isalpha():
            if inside and not prev_letter:
                word_count += 1
            elif not inside:
                cur_len += 1
                if cur_len > max_len:
                    max_len = cur_len
            prev_letter = True
        else:
            prev_letter = False
            cur_len = 0
        i += 1
    
    return [max_len, word_count]

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    res = document_analyser(s)
    print(f"{res[0]} {res[1]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
